# Vedant Anand - Agentic Payments & x402 Engineer

> I build payment infrastructure for AI agents. Co-founder of Bags, an agentic commerce platform that let any API charge AI agents per request over the x402 protocol. Three merged pull requests to the x402 protocol repository. Production Solidity and full-stack TypeScript. Based in Punjab, India. Available now for contract and part-time work.

## About

Vedant Anand builds agentic commerce and stablecoin payment infrastructure. He co-founded Bags, which let any API charge AI agents per request over x402 — pay-per-call links that quoted a price, verified a USDC payment across four chains, then returned the response, with merchant-of-record compliance and tax invoicing underneath. Bags reached 100,000+ cumulative visitors, was backed by Founders Inc. and Superteam, and was part of Canopy, the Founders Inc. builder cohort. It was wound down in 2026 for lack of product-market fit.

He is also a contributor to x402 itself, the HTTP-native standard for paying for API calls in stablecoins, with three merged pull requests to the protocol repository. He is pursuing a Bachelor's in Electrical and Computer Engineering at Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology (2023-2027) and graduates in 2027, which does not affect contract availability.

## Availability

**Available now for contract and part-time work**, remote from India, working UK, EU and US hours. Up to 30 hrs/week.

- Solidity / smart contracts — $70/hour
- Full-stack TypeScript / Next.js — $55/hour
- Protocol research and technical writing — $900 per deep-dive piece, or $75/hour ongoing
- x402 / agentic payments integration — fixed price from $3,500, typically 1–2 weeks
- Part-time retainer — from $7,500/month

Rate card and services: https://vedant-dev.com/hire

## Featured Projects

- [Bags](https://www.getbags.app/) - Agentic commerce platform: pay-per-call APIs charging AI agents in USDC over x402 across four chains. 100,000+ cumulative visitors, backed by Founders Inc. and Superteam. Wound down in 2026.
- x402 protocol contributions - Three merged pull requests to the x402 protocol repository: [EIP-2612 permit-signing tests](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/2344), [ERC-20 approval gas constants](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/2278), and [extensions documentation](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/731)
- [AgentPay](https://agentpay.vedant-dev.com/) - An agent that pays per request for sentiment analysis and trading signals over x402
- [Timelock Protocol](https://timelock.trade) - Modern landing page for DeFi options trading platform with quantum-secured positions
- [Veri Doc](https://veri-doc.vercel.app/) - Decentralized document verification using zero-knowledge proofs
